style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Tree Candle Holder
style.toneOfVoice: Add sparkle to your seasonal décor with this 19.5cm tree candle holder—a dazzling accent that brings warmth, elegance, and a hint of whimsy to any space. Shaped like a stylised Christmas tree and finished in a radiant tone, this candle holder is perfect for creating a cosy, glowing ambiance during the holiday season and beyond. Whether styled on a mantel, dining table, or entryway console, it’s a beautiful blend of function and festive charm—ideal for both modern and traditional holiday aesthetics. Let this golden tree shine bright and light up your holidays with style and sophistication. Candle Holder Dims: D4.5xH2cm. Recommended for indoor use only.
